title: You Are What You Prompt: Prompt Quality, Domain Shift, and Uncertainty in Agrifood Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18116v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models enable zero-shot classification through natural language prompts, but performance is sensitive to prompt formulation, especially in specialized domains. Zero-shot Prompt Ensembling (ZPE) addresses this by weighting prompts by discriminative signal, yet its behavior under domain shift remains unexplored. We evaluate ZPE in the agrifood domain using CLIP and SigLIP across four datasets and four prompt pools, spanning in-distribution (ID) food and out-of-distribution agricultural benchmarks. ZPE provides limited benefit under ID conditions but substantially improves performance and calibration under domain shift, where domain-specific pools of 51-52 prompts consistently outperform generic pools of 247-426. Lexical analysis shows that ZPE acts as an unsupervised domain-alignment detector without label access. We further introduce PID (Prompt-based Inconsistency Detection), which repurposes prompt disagreement as episte

translated_title: 你即你所提示：农业食品视觉语言模型中的提示质量、领域偏移与不确定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18116v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视觉语言模型通过自然语言提示实现零样本分类，但性能对提示形式敏感，尤其在专业领域中。零样本提示集成（ZPE）通过根据判别信号加权提示来解决这一问题，但其在领域偏移下的行为尚未被探索。我们在农业食品领域使用CLIP和SigLIP评估了ZPE，涵盖四个数据集和四个提示池，包括分布内（ID）食品和分布外农业基准。ZPE在ID条件下提供有限益处，但在领域偏移下显著提升性能和校准，其中特定领域的51-52个提示池始终优于通用247-426个提示池。词汇分析显示，ZPE在无需标签访问的情况下充当无监督领域对齐检测器。我们进一步引入基于提示的不一致性检测（PID），将提示分歧重新用作认知不确定性指标。
tldr: 该论文发现零样本提示集成（ZPE）在农业食品视觉语言模型中，于领域偏移条件下显著提升性能与校准，并提出基于提示的不一致性检测（PID）作为无监督领域对齐和不确定性评估的新方法。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that zero-shot prompt ensembling (ZPE) significantly improves performance and calibration under domain shift in agrifood vision-language models, and introduces prompt-based inconsistency detection (PID) as a novel unsupervised method for domain alignment and uncertainty estimation.
